entities.name: Pharasmanes III of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pharasmanes III or P’arsman III was a king (mepe) of Iberia, a contemporary of the Roman emperor Antoninus Pius (138–161). Professor Cyril Toumanoff suggests 135–185 AD as the possible years of Pharasmanes’ rule.
